page_title: Video Background Remover: Remove video backgrounds | Canva

summary.name: Canva Video Background Remover
summary.one_liner: A one-click AI tool in Canva's online video editor that automatically removes a video's background so the subject can be placed on a new scene.
use_cases: Remove background from a product or tutorial video
Place a presenter on a new scene without a green screen
Replace a video background with a template or stock image
Avoid reshooting footage in a different location
summary.what_it_does: The Video Background Remover in Canva's online video editor uses machine-learning to detect the main subject in a video and mask it, with the mask carried across all frames. The background becomes transparent, so a new image or video can be layered behind the subject. Users upload a video, choose Background Remover under Tools (or BG Remover on the toolbar), and then position layers. The page also describes other editor features such as subtitles, filters, speed adjustment, AI music generation, Magic Design for Video and Magic Resize. Finished videos download as MP4.
notable: One-click AI subject masking applied across all video frames
No green screen or manual rotoscoping required
Integrated with Canva's template and media library
caveats: The background remover is labeled (Pro), so it requires Canva Pro
Page is Canva marketing; the listing describes the tool as unscreen.com but the page itself is Canva's
